Revised cost table
Each psychic power increases Warp Pressure. Empowering a power now concretely changes the power
and increases risk.
Power Type Warp Pressure Cost
Minor Power +1 Warp Pressure
Standard Power +2 Warp Pressure
Major Power +3 Warp Pressure
Empowered Power +1 additional Warp Pressure, plus one Empowered effect below
Empowered Option Effect
Overcharged Damage If the power deals damage, add one additional damage die of the 
same type.
Brutal Manifestation If the power requires a saving throw, increase the Psychic Save 
DC by +1 for that casting.
Extended Reach Increase the range by 30 ft, or increase a cone/area radius by 5 ft.
Sustained Focus If the power grants temporary hit points, healing, protection, or a 
bonus, increase the value by your proficiency bonus.
Split Manifestation If the power targets one creature and does not already affect 
multiple targets, target one additional creature within 10 ft of the 
original target. The second target takes half damage or receives 
half the non-damage effect, GM adjudication.
Discipline Mastery If the power belongs to your chosen discipline, you may reroll one 
damage die or healing die from the power.
Empowered restriction
A power can only be Empowered once per casting. Empowering a power always increases Warp Pressure
before the Perils roll is made. Minor powers can be empowered, but doing so is reckless and should feel
dangerous at low levels.
